Creamy Onion, Celery and Potato Soup. 
Ingredients
• 2 tablespoons olive oil 
• 1 onion, diced 
• 2 stalks celery, diced 
• 2 potatoes, chopped 
• 2 cloves garlic, minced 
• Salt and pepper to taste 
• 4 cups vegetable broth 
• ¼ cup cream cheese 
• ½ cup cream 
Instructions
